about: Hand-run eval set for the archiyou skill and CLI. An agent session solves each prompt into <dir>/<id>.js, then `archiyou eval <dir>` scores the builds, the size (per axis, within tolerance), the volume (volumeTolerance, else tolerance), the number of parameters, a clean sweep and the inventory check. Axes: x width, y depth (front at y = 0), z up. Used to compare a skill or docs change before and after; see plans/AI_TEXT2CAD_HARNASS.md.

items.prompt: A steel plate 200 x 120 x 20 mm with a 10 mm hole through it 15 mm in from each corner.
An L-bracket bent from 5 mm plate, 30 mm wide (along y): a 60 mm leg lying on the floor along x and a 40 mm leg standing up at one end, each with a 6 mm hole in the middle.
A table 1000 x 500 mm and 720 mm high: four 60 x 60 mm legs set in 40 mm from the edges, a 30 mm thick top. Make length, width and height parameters.
A wall shelf unit from 18 mm boards, 800 wide, 300 deep, 1200 high: two sides, a top, a bottom and evenly spaced shelves, the number of shelves a parameter (2 to 8, default 4).
A two-step stool from 18 mm plywood, 400 mm wide: steps at 220 and 440 mm, the lower step 200 mm deep in front of the upper one, the upper step 250 mm deep, closed sides. Step heights as parameters.

A timber stud wall 3000 long and 2600 high from 38 x 140 mm studs at 600 mm centres, with a bottom and top plate and one window opening 1200 wide and 1000 high, its sill at 900 mm, centred in the wall. Opening width, height and sill as parameters.
A storage box 300 x 200 x 150 mm from 12 mm boards with a loose lid of 12 mm on top (total height 162). Width, depth and height as parameters.

Model this chair from the photos as a parametric Archiyou script. Name the parts: frontLegL/R, middlePostL/R, rearPostL/R, railL/R, armL/R, seat, back, and the crossbars crossbarSeatFront, crossbarSeatRear, crossbarFrontBottom, crossbarBackFoot, crossbarBackTop. Its published size is 66 x 83 x 88 cm.
